📒 *known issue recurrence* — `ki-2026-05-24-runtime-core-rtc-p95-recurring`
This is occurrence #34 in the last 7 days (37 total since 2026-05-23).

DD monitor 115456700 *RTC Screen Load has a high p95 latency* re-fired in #alert-system. Spike confirmed: `p95 trace.aspnet_core.request{service:runtime-core-api,resource_name:post_/api/v1/runtime/load/_screenid*}` peaked at **10.08s @ 12:03:20Z** (vs 3s threshold, ratio 2.36×), recovered to <2s within ~40s. Zero error logs on `service:runtime-core-api status:error env:prod` in window — canonical latency-only ki-24 signature.

No deploys: `runtime-core` HEAD `1f179c6d2` unchanged since 2026-05-06 (26 days). Not a code regression.

*Playbook:* (1) confirm latency-only via DD logs (zero errors ✅), (2) inspect outlier traces in spike window for slow span (SQL/Mongo/Redis), (3) tag breakdown by `@account_name` / per-tenant DB. (4) Mitigation options pending root cause: bump threshold to 4s (mask), add per-resource circuit breaker (medium), or profile slowest accounts and index-fix (root). Open Jira: none.

📒 *known issue recurrence — milestone* — `ki-2026-05-21-gateway-microservices-timeout`
This is occurrence **#100** since 2026-05-20 (~12 days). Every-10th-occurrence resurface trigger fired despite the 24h suppression window (last notified 2026-06-01 14:15Z, 5h53m ago).

**Group:** 14 alerts in #alert-frontend-errors over 52 min (19:10:13Z → 20:02:12Z), all monitor 77419271 "Unusual number of XHR errors for account".

**Chronic, not regression:**
• ES RequestTimedOutError+GetSyncWidgetInfoAsync: **14.4/min this hour vs 15.7/min prior hour (−8%)** — inside today's chronic band 13.6–16.1/min.
• ≥10 distinct accounts in DD log sample, broad fan-out (proxy-layer, not per-tenant).
• No m-one or ms-gateway-api deploy in 4h pre-alert window.

**Playbook:** ms-gateway-api Ocelot ResponderMiddleware timing out while proxying to microservices.method.int Tier-3 IIS pool. Decision still pending — fix options: (a) raise per-route Ocelot timeout, (b) scale/shorten microservices pool recycle, (c) profile upstream sync-util/preferences/account for the slow path.

**Standing ask:** `fix_status: needs-ops-decision`, `fix_jira: null`, **13 days open**. The 100-occurrence milestone is a natural decision point — recommend either filing a Jira to commit to one of (a)/(b)/(c), or formally closing this as "won't fix, accept chronic noise" so we can tune the monitor threshold instead.

Open Jira: (none)
Investigation: docs/investigations/2026-06-01-e29bf334ab08b4de.md
